facts.fact: The Council of Ministers approved ANSIE's (state digital agency) 2026 budget at 396,120,056 DJF, of which 108.1m DJF is investment (firewalls, archiving, datacentre backup, X-Road support); revenue is mainly the state subvention.
ANSIE's 2026 budget of 396.1m DJF is down 160.6m DJF from 556.7m DJF in 2025, a fall of about 29%, which the record ties to the creation of a separate National Cybersecurity Authority.

note: ARMD is a multisector regulator; its 2026 budget (258.1m DJF, up from 218.8m) is not a digital agency line and gives no fact.
